title: Why Is a Guava Gritty? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A soft potato, a gritty guava and a strong jute rope all come from plants. Diya bites into a guava and asks what the tiny hard grains are, and why a plant is soft in one place and tough in another.

You will meet the five permanent tissues of a plant in one living diagram: parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma (fibres and sclereids) as the simple tissues, then xylem and phloem as the complex tissues, with water moving up and food moving through sieve tubes controlled by companion cells. Then xylem vs phloem side by side, a pause and think check, a worked matching example, the exam trap about vessels in gymnosperms, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to answer. This is Episode 50 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.
